name: passninja
description: Issue and manage Apple Wallet & Google Wallet passes from any MCP-aware AI client.
long_description:
Lets you create, update, list, and revoke Apple Wallet and Google Wallet passes by asking your AI assistant in natural language. Wraps the full PassNinja REST API surface — pass templates, issued passes, webhooks — as MCP tools.

Typical prompts:
- "Issue a new Run Tulum membership pass for jane@example.com."
- "List my pass templates and tell me how many passes are installed on each."
- "Show me the raw pass.json for serial fee4a257185906b92a on ptk_0x216."
- "Create a webhook that POSTs to https://example.com/hook on pass.installed events."

Requires a PassNinja account. Get an API key + account id at https://www.passninja.com/settings.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Your PassNinja API key. Find it https://www.passninja.com/settings → API key. Treated as a secret — stored in your OS keychain.

account_id.title: Account ID
account_id.description: Your PassNinja account ID, e.g. aid_0x002. Find it on the same page as your API key.

base_url.title: API base URL
base_url.description: Override only if you're pointing at staging/dev. Default is production.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Show which PassNinja account this MCP is configured for.

tools.name: pass_template_list
tools.description: List every pass template on the account.

tools.name: pass_template_get
tools.description: Fetch one pass template by ptk_0x... id.

tools.name: pass_template_required_fields
tools.description: Show the field names a pass_create call must populate for a template.

tools.name: pass_template_create
tools.description: Create a new pass template (enterprise only).

tools.name: pass_template_delete
tools.description: Hard-delete a pass template and every pass on it (enterprise only, destructive).

tools.name: pass_list
tools.description: List every pass issued on a template.

tools.name: pass_get
tools.description: Fetch one issued pass by serial.

tools.name: pass_create
tools.description: Issue a new pass on a template.

tools.name: pass_update
tools.description: Update an issued pass (PATCH by default, PUT with replace=true).

tools.name: pass_delete
tools.description: Revoke an issued pass (destructive — the wallet card is invalidated).

tools.name: pass_raw
tools.description: Dump the raw pass.json payload for an issued pass.

tools.name: pass_decrypt
tools.description: Decrypt a reader-encrypted NFC payload with the template's private key.

tools.name: webhook_list
tools.description: List webhook subscriptions on the account.

tools.name: webhook_get
tools.description: Fetch one webhook subscription by id.

tools.name: webhook_create
tools.description: Create a webhook subscription. Bearer token is surfaced only on this call.

tools.name: webhook_delete
tools.description: Delete a webhook subscription (destructive — also cascades its result history).

tools.name: webhook_results
tools.description: Paginate the delivery history of a webhook.

tools.name: pass_template_reader_config
tools.description: Return the NFC reader config (Apple merchant id, Google collector id + key version, EC decryption keys) for a pass template.

tools.name: pass_template_update
tools.description: Update a pass template's name, fields, and install-constraint / disable-sharing / top-up configuration.

tools.name: application_list
tools.description: List scan-event applications on the account.

tools.name: application_get
tools.description: Fetch one scan-event application by app_0x... id.

tools.name: application_create
tools.description: Create a scan-event application bound to one pass template (kind: log | validate | forward).

tools.name: application_update
tools.description: Update a scan-event application's name, kind, config, or active state.

tools.name: application_delete
tools.description: Delete a scan-event application (refused while bound to a reader).

tools.name: reader_list
tools.description: List registered NFC readers with bindings, hardware identity, and last-seen time.

tools.name: reader_get
tools.description: Fetch one registered NFC reader with health, hardware, and bindings.

tools.name: reader_create
tools.description: Register an NFC reader and mint its one-time bearer token.

tools.name: reader_update
tools.description: Update a reader's name, location, status, or application bindings.

tools.name: reader_delete
tools.description: Delete a registered NFC reader.

tools.name: reader_config
tools.description: Return the merged reader config across every template a reader is bound to.
